hero.title: We build software for operations, events and businesses in Bandung.

projects.label: Projects
projects.title: What we're working on
projects.intro: Three products, each with its actual status today.

inventory.name: Inventory System
inventory.desc: A web app for recording goods coming in and going out. A client uses it every day.
points: Runs in the browser, nothing to install

ngebooth.name: NgeBooth
ngebooth.desc: A photobooth app for events. Take photos, lay them out as a strip, then print.

rfid.name: RFID Attendance
rfid.desc: Tap a card on the reader and attendance shows up on the dashboard.

items.title: Web apps and dashboards
items.body: For operational work that still lives on paper or in a spreadsheet.
